gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic reads compact and tidy, its lowercase sitting nearly level with the capitals and its curve endings held well apart. And Tilt Neon, drawn like glowing tube with a splayed c terminal, gives that sans a loud, bold partner.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-north-: Tube-bright and loud. Tilt Neon's cord-like strokes lead boldly, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band whose outward-pointing terminals give the whole pairing its odd tension.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Tilt Neon's strokes look like cut ribbon, one constant width, with a splayed c terminal and a large x-height under short ascenders. It shouts; Noto Sans Old Permic simply stays open and approachable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-persia: Tilt Neon's thickness never changes with direction, so every letter looks like glowing tube bent into shape, bold and commanding. And Noto Sans Old Persian answers it with lofty, tall lowercase whose open counters breathe, a gentler neighbor.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Noto Sans Old Sogdian reads crisp and friendly, its tall x-height nearly touching cap height and its wide mouths staying open. But Tilt Neon is the loud one, with unvarying line weight and a splayed c terminal built for display.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic brings chunky, tall lowercase and open-mouthed curves that stay clear. Meanwhile Noto Sans Old Turkic handles the quiet work, as Tilt Neon, with its one fixed nib width, takes the bold, commanding spotlight.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Tilt Neon has no thick and thin parts in any letter, just a bold tube-like line with a splayed c terminal. But Noto Sans Oriya follows with generous curve gaps and small letters almost as tall as capitals, a friendly plain sans.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up. Tilt Neon, by contrast, looks bent from a single wire, and Noto Sans Osage leaves the bold shouting to it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Loud wire-bright heading letters meet a body font with oversized lowercase and wide, easy s turns. Tilt Neon traces each letter in constant weight, and Noto Sans Osmanya keeps a long read smooth.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmo: Tilt Neon holds its stroke width constant, with a splayed c terminal and a large x-height under short ascenders, all bold swagger. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong grounds it with a high-set x-height.
